meta.notes: Figure Eight (playtest 3, T10.6; the progression plan's drift race, the maintainer: "Braking into a hairpin at speeds makes a nice drift like mechanism"). A race to the line up Twin Peaks (11 corners, 3 hairpins) whose second required objective is $300 of drift style cash (the HUD reads DRIFT $x/$300; other style does not count); the optional podium bonus is the usual 0.15 W. The target is capped at 60 % of what the scripted drift bot banks on this route alone, at this event's own drift rate ($45 a second of full slip, 3 times the oncoming rate) on the weakest bike a player could own by then: $523 on the Superbike, so a cap of $314, and the target is $300, rounded down to $50 (tests/sim/drift-events.test.ts fails any drift event over its cap). The purse, the style rewards and the rival pace are global tier 11's. [default] every number.
